entries.summary: Initial repo creation. Added README, CLAUDE.md, TODO, protocols (Flywheel, Memory), definition, and Matt Prime agent.

Added SWEAT440 brand law document and competitive intelligence agent. Brand law covers name formatting, forbidden words, positioning anchor, typography, and color palette. Competitive agent is scoped to weekly sweeps of F45, OrangeTheory, Solidcore, and Barry's, producing internal-only decision-ready briefs.

Ran first competitive sweep. Researched F45, OrangeTheory, Solidcore, and Barry's for the week of 2026-05-24. Key findings: OTF launching Season of Strength challenge (June 1–July 26, $35 registration); Solidcore expanded Core Collective wellness partnership program; Barry's hit 100 studios and launched LIFT strength-only modality; F45 sustaining 'This Is F45 Training' global campaign. All four competitors are converging on strength positioning and lifestyle ecosystem expansion. Three decision options surfaced for Matt's review.

Added reporting agent. Consolidation-only agent that reads other agents' weekly brief outputs and produces a single decision-ready scorecard. No web searches, no new findings. Saves scorecards to agents/reporting/scorecards/YYYY-MM-DD.md and follows full Memory write-back protocol.
